description: Final-week average, retrospective model, initial exit polls, result and recent individual polls. Eligible poll dates are fieldwork end dates. include_publication_only adds excluded records with unconfirmed fieldwork_end and the 2026 publisher channel aliases.

election_id.description: latest, a Knesset ID such as k26, or full YYYY-MM-DD date. A bare 2019 is ambiguous.

include_publication_only.description: Include records with publication dates but unconfirmed fieldwork dates; these remain excluded from calculated averages. Default false.

include_series.description: Include the historical polling time series when true; default false.

limit.description: Number of recent individual polls to return, 0–25; default 5. Zero omits recent polls while retaining aggregates.

name: get_polls
